name: nexusai-pro-desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for Nexus AI Pro — secure IPC, auto-update, native OS integration.

scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.release: npm run bundle && npm run build && electron-builder --publish always
